desc:
⛏️ Mine for treasure. Watch your back.

Grab your pickaxe and head underground! Mine valuable ores, sell your haul, and upgrade your equipment at camp. Venture deeper for rarer discoveries—but stay alert. You aren't the only thing exploring these caves.

💎 Uncover rare ores hidden inside the rock.
🛠️ Upgrade your pickaxe, backpack, scanner, and weapons.
🗺️ Explore hidden caverns, winding mazes, and mysterious chambers.
👥 Bring your friends and face the underground together.
👁️ Watch for monsters lurking in the darkness.

How far will you go for your next big discovery?

🎧 Headphones recommended.
⚠️ Contains jump scares.
